_comments: Machine-written. Do not edit by hand unless you are deliberately resetting something.
last_run_iso ............. Timestamp of the last run that actually sent a brief.
Guards against a double send when both cron entries fire.
last_known_balance ....... Most recent balance the bank API returned, in dollars.
last_known_balance_iso ... When that balance was read. If the bank API is down, the
stale-data text quotes both of these so you know how old
alerted_days ............. ISO date -> the projected balance for that day at the time
it was last alerted about. Used to suppress repeat alerts
and to re-alert only when a day gets materially worse.
last_message_hash ........ SHA-256 of the last daily brief body. Lets a rerun notice
it would send an identical message.
